common.errorBody: The page hit a problem. Retry, or head back home.
common.notFoundBody: The link may be stale, or the content was deleted.
common.requestFailed: Request failed — is the backend running?

chat.emptyHint: Ask a question, paste a problem, or attach a document — answers come with citations from your knowledge base.
chat.placeholder: Ask anything… Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline
chat.placeholderMastery: Ask anything about this path, or just say "continue" — it checks you against the next objective
chat.knowledgeHint: Questions in this session search the selected knowledge bases; none selected means no retrieval
chat.modelHint: This session keeps using the selected model; the default follows Settings
chat.modelMissingKey: No API key configured (add one in Settings → Model)
chat.capabilityHint: Later turns in this session use the selected capability; chat by default
chat.capabilityBusy: Cannot switch capability while a turn is running
chat.capabilityChatHint: Ask and answer, with knowledge bases and tools
chat.capabilityMasteryHint: The gate is the cursor: the next objective is recomputed every turn, questions are asked and graded right in chat, and a cleared node is skipped automatically
chat.capabilityResearchHint: Clarify → decompose → research → report: you confirm the outline first, then it digs up sources and writes a cited report
chat.capabilityVisualizeHint: Turn a request into a diagram, chart, flow, or interactive page
chat.capabilityMathAnimatorHint: Generate a video animation explaining a math idea (needs Manim + ffmpeg locally)
chat.researchDepthHint: Depth decides how many subtopics and how many search rounds each
chat.researchDepthHint_quick: Fewer subtopics, one usable answer, fastest
chat.researchDepthHint_standard: Four subtopics, three search rounds each — enough for most questions
chat.researchDepthHint_deep: Six or more subtopics and more rounds; coverage over speed
chat.researchModeHint: What you get at the end
chat.researchModeHint_report: Written in sections, with a reference list at the end
chat.researchModeHint_answer: One coherent answer, no sections, still cited
chat.visualizeRenderTypeHint: Which renderer draws this figure; auto lets the model decide
chat.visualizeRenderTypeHint_auto: Pick the most fitting type for the request
chat.visualizeRenderTypeHint_svg: Vector diagram with full control over shapes and layout
chat.visualizeRenderTypeHint_echarts: Standard charts for quantitative data (line, bar, pie, …)
chat.animatorQualityHint: Higher quality renders slower; try low first, re-run high when happy
chat.animatorQualityHint_low: Fastest, good for a quick look (480p)
chat.animatorQualityHint_medium: Default balance of clarity and speed (720p)
chat.animatorQualityHint_high: Sharpest and slowest, for the final take (1080p)
chat.askFreeTextHint: You can also write it in your own words
chat.quizNotAnswered: No answer this time — it will be asked again

render.playbackFailed: Playback isn't working — download it and open it locally

playground.title: Visualization playground
playground.subtitle: Ask on the left, get the figure on the right — each request runs a visualize turn
playground.placeholder: Describe what to draw, e.g. “draw a sine curve” or “show bubble sort as a flowchart”
playground.empty: Nothing here yet — send a request on the left
playground.busy: A turn is still running in this session; wait for it (or stop it in chat) — the playground won't switch sessions now
playground.hint: Figures can be saved to a notebook; follow up in chat for details

models.providerDesc: Empty = follow NNNU_MODEL env / built-in default (DeepSeek)
models.baseUrlDesc: Empty = provider default endpoint; required for custom
models.modelDesc: Empty = provider's default model; free text supported
models.apiKeyDesc: Stored in user-secrets only, never written into settings JSON; replies show a mask only
models.searchProviderDesc: Empty = Bing (China, no key needed); pick Bocha / SearXNG / SerpAPI-compatible as needed
models.searchBaseUrlDesc: Empty = provider default; set this for a self-hosted SearXNG or similar
models.imageModelDesc: Empty = provider's default image model; uses the OpenAI-compatible images API
models.embeddingProviderDesc: Empty = local small model (bge-small-zh-v1.5, ~95MB downloaded on first use); remote = an OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint
models.embeddingBaseUrlDesc: Required for remote mode, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1
models.embeddingModelDesc: Empty = bge-small-zh-v1.5 in local mode; for remote, use the provider's model name
models.embeddingApiKeyDesc: Stored in user-secrets only, never written into settings JSON; replies show a mask only

chat.toolsEnabledDesc: One tool name per line. For "my condition isn't met but I want it anyway" — e.g. attachment_search with no attachments. Rarely needed: toggleable tools are already on.
chat.toolsDisabledDesc: One tool name per line; listed tools are not mounted for the turn (disabling wins over enabling). exec sits here by default — it runs commands on this machine, so delete the line only if you want it.
chat.sandboxNetworkDesc: Lets code_execution and exec reach the network (off by default). Code still has to request network itself per call; credentials and proxy variables never enter the sandbox.

kb.chunkSizeDesc: PDF is split by page, then merged up to this length within a page; too large blurs retrieval, too small cuts sentences
kb.chunkOverlapDesc: Overlap between neighbouring chunks so a sentence cut in half is still findable on both sides
kb.embeddingBatchSizeDesc: How many chunks go to the embedder at once; smaller is safer for remote endpoints, larger is faster locally
kb.parseEngineDesc: Empty = pick by file type (PDF goes through PyMuPDF and keeps page numbers); P4 only ships the automatic path — other values fall back to it with a warning

memory.autoEnabledDesc: Run a consolidation pass automatically once the threshold is reached (background; never blocks chat).
memory.autoThresholdTurnsDesc: Turns since the last consolidation that trigger a new pass; a pass only consumes events after the watermark (incremental).
memory.injectEnabledDesc: Attach a short profile-memory excerpt (~700 chars) to the first message of a session; when off, the model sees memory only if it calls read_memory.
memory.budgetUpdateDesc: Max fact-updating steps per pass (0 disables this step).
memory.budgetAuditDesc: Max reference-auditing steps per pass; entries with dead refs are marked STALE, never silently deleted.
memory.budgetExtractDesc: Max LLM calls per consolidation pass for the knowledge graph (0 = off).
memory.updateChunkCharsDesc: New events are chunked at this size before the model sees them: bigger costs more, smaller loses context.
memory.traceEnabledDesc: Record user messages / tool calls / conclusions per turn into L1; when off, L2/L3 stop getting new material.

settings.appearanceDesc: Theme and language — takes effect instantly after Apply.
settings.modelsDesc: LLM connection — a connectivity probe runs on Apply; failure keeps the current config.
settings.chatDesc: Tool toggles — Apply takes effect immediately; the next turn mounts tools per these switches.
settings.memoryDesc: Thresholds and LLM budgets for the three-layer memory — apply to take effect from the next pass.
settings.kbDesc: Chunking and embedding parameters for local knowledge bases; rebuild the index in Knowledge Center after changing them
settings.toolsDesc: Every built-in tool (click for its parameter schema). Always = mounted every turn; Context = mounted when its condition holds; Toggleable = on by default, turns off when listed under Disable. Not ready = a prerequisite is missing (e.g. no image model set), so it cannot run yet.
settings.toolsLoadFailed: Could not load the tool list — is the backend running?
settings.draftSaved: Draft saved — click Apply to take effect

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.desc: Drop in slides, papers and books — chat can cite them down to the page.
knowledge.empty: No knowledge base yet. Create one and add some files.
knowledge.nameRequired: Give the knowledge base a name first.
knowledge.filesHint: PDF / text / Office documents, up to 200MB each
knowledge.deleteKbConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Documents and index go with it, no way back.
knowledge.deleteDocConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Its content drops out of the index right away.
knowledge.noDocs: This base is empty — add some files first.
knowledge.rebuildingHint: Rebuilding v{n}, the old index still answers queries
knowledge.searchAllDesc: Search across every ready library — hits carry their library name and open right at the document.
knowledge.searchPlaceholder: Ask a question or type keywords…
knowledge.readerPdfHint: Page anchors depend on the browser's PDF viewer: Chrome / Edge jump to the page, Firefox needs manual scrolling.
knowledge.openOriginal: Open the original in a new tab
knowledge.readerLoadError: Couldn't load the preview — download the original instead.
knowledge.readerTooLarge: File is too large to preview here — download it instead.
knowledge.readerOfficeTextHint: Showing the extracted text — the same content the model reads. Download the original for full formatting.
knowledge.readerDocxError: Couldn't render this Word document — download it and open it in Office.
knowledge.readerXlsxError: Couldn't render this spreadsheet — download it and open it in Excel.
knowledge.readerXlsxTruncated: Large sheet — preview truncated. Download for the full file.
knowledge.readerNoSheets: This workbook has no sheets to preview.
knowledge.readerFallback: Preview is not available for this file type.
knowledge.notFound: This knowledge base does not exist, or it was deleted.

notebooks.title: Notebooks
notebooks.desc: Keep solutions, answers and quick notes here so you can find them later.
notebooks.emptyHint: Create one, or hit "Save to notebook" on any answer in the chat.
notebooks.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Its records go with it.
notebooks.notFound: This notebook does not exist or was deleted.
notebooks.noteTitlePlaceholder: Title (leave empty to use the first line)
notebooks.notePlaceholder: Write something… Markdown and LaTeX supported

questions.title: Question Bank
questions.desc: Questions from quiz turns, from chat, and ones you wrote yourself — answer them and review mistakes here.
questions.emptyHint: Pick the "Quiz" capability in chat to generate a batch, or click "New question" to write one.
questions.optionsRequired: A choice question needs at least two options
questions.optionsPlaceholder: One option per line (labels A/B/C/D are assigned in order)
questions.answerPlaceholder: Correct answer: B for single choice, ABD for multi choice
questions.keyPlaceholder: Reference answer (grading treats it as authoritative)
questions.deleteConfirm: Delete this question? Its attempt history goes with it.
questions.notePlaceholder: Mistakes, takeaways, pitfalls… (Markdown; AI classification reads it)
questions.classifyHint: Let the AI read the stem, answer, and your note, then fill in topic, tags, and error causes
questions.similarEmpty: Nothing similar yet — generate a few variants.
questions.similarLowConfidence: Stem is short, so similarity is only indicative.
questions.variantsDegraded: No usable knowledge-base material; generated with AI only.
questions.variantsPreviewHint: Tick the ones to keep — nothing is saved until you adopt.
questions.variantsDup: {percent}% similar to the closest question in your bank — check for duplicates.
questions.variantsAdoptDone: Adopted {n} — they show up in the list below.

learning.title: Learning paths
learning.desc: Four node types: memory/procedure clear on a score (90), concept/design clear when you explain them in your own words. The next objective is recomputed server-side every turn — nothing to advance by hand.
learning.emptyHint: Paths are created in chat: hit “New learning path” to open a learning session, or switch the capability to “Learning path” and say “build me a learning path for linear algebra”.
learning.notFound: This learning path does not exist or was deleted.
learning.cardGoHint: Open this path's chat (switches the learning session; progress untouched)
learning.leaveSessionHint: Unbind the chat session from this path. Progress, questions and attempts all stay; “Study in chat” brings it back.
learning.leftNotice: Chat detached — progress stays in the path.
learning.noWeakPoints: No weak points yet. Nodes you practiced but did not clear show up here.
learning.noReviews: No review scheduled yet. Mastering a node schedules one.
learning.strategy_memory: Give the anchor straight away — mnemonics, contrast tables, the usual mix-ups — then hammer it with questions.
learning.strategy_procedure: Give followable steps, demonstrate once, then let them walk it; teach whichever step they stall on.
learning.strategy_concept: Define it, make it intuitive, pin it with one example, then quiz.
learning.strategy_design: Ask about constraints and trade-offs first, then weigh options together; there is no single answer — what matters is that they can say why.
learning.skipQuestionHint: Drop the question in flight (mastery and attempts stay as they are) and move on
learning.redoPathConfirm: Redo “{title}”? Mastery, verdicts, review schedule and attempts all reset; the node tree and questions stay.
learning.deletePathConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Its nodes go too; questions on them become unassigned.
learning.deleteNodeConfirm: Delete node “{title}”? Its child nodes go with it.

research.title: Research history
research.subtitle: Every deep-research run: outline, report and sources
research.empty: No runs yet — switch the capability to Deep Research in chat and ask a question
research.noOutline: This run has no outline on record
research.noReportConfirming: Waiting for you to confirm the outline — the report has not started
research.noReportResearching: Researching — the report is not ready yet
research.noReportAbandoned: This run stopped early, so there is no report
research.noReportDeleted: The report is gone — its message or session was deleted
research.deleteRunning: Still running — wait for it to finish, or stop it first
research.deleteConfirm: Delete the research run "{topic}"? Only this history row goes; the session and its messages stay.

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: Three-layer long-term memory: L1 trace → L2 fact entries → L3 profile. Manual edits are protected from consolidation.
memory.emptyDoc: No entries here yet. Chat a few turns and come back.
memory.deleteConfirm: Delete this memory? "{text}" — the next consolidation won't write it back.
memory.releaseConfirm: Hand back to automatic management? Consolidation may edit it again.
memory.staleHint: The referenced event line is stale; the next audit will refresh it
memory.anonymousHint: Hand-written entries get an id at the next consolidation; only then can they be edited or deleted
memory.l1Empty: No trace for this surface yet. Chat or run a capability first.
memory.graphHint: L3 profile → L2 facts → L1 events. Click any L3 node to expand down to raw events.
memory.graphExpandedHint: Showing this node's evidence chain; click further nodes or reset to the overview.
memory.graphEmpty: Nothing to draw yet — chat a few turns, or hit Consolidate now.
memory.semanticHint: Entities and relations extracted from memory entries (for reference; older entries fade out of the extraction window).
memory.semanticEmpty: No knowledge graph yet — set the extraction budget above 0 in settings, then hit Consolidate.
memory.semanticStale: Memory changed since the last extraction — hit Consolidate to refresh the graph.
